title: 橋墩纖維複材耐震補強~FRP seismic strengthening of bridge piers
focus: 以環向纖維複材套管提供圍束、剪力與搭接夾持，補足舊橋墩的韌性缺陷而不增加彎矩強度~Hoop-direction FRP jackets that add confinement, shear strength and splice clamping to old piers without raising flexural strength
summary: 從舊橋墩的剪力、圍束與柱底搭接三種缺陷出發，說明纖維複材套管為何只沿環向布纖維、如何以側向圍束壓力與有效應變計算層數與剪力貢獻，再處理表面處理、露點與圓角、濕式積層、拉拔與脫層檢驗、補強前後反覆載重驗證、紫外線與撞擊耐久以及震後量測，並以賓州 I-84 跨越橋 1995 年的塑鉸區包覆與舊金山碼頭 250 支沉箱套管為例。~Starting from the three deficiencies of old piers — shear, confinement and base lap splices — explain why FRP jackets place fibres only in the hoop direction and how confining pressure and effective strain set ply count and shear contribution, then cover surface preparation, dew point and corner rounding, wet lay-up, pull-off and delamination checks, cyclic validation before and after retrofit, UV and impact durability and post-earthquake measurement, using the 1995 plastic-hinge wrapping of a Pennsylvania I-84 overpass and jackets on about 250 caissons of a San Francisco pier.

units.anchor: 舊橋墩三種缺陷~Three deficiencies of old piers
units.title: 舊橋墩的耐震缺陷與補強策略~Seismic deficiencies of old piers and retrofit strategy
units.mechanism: 1970 年代以前設計的橋墩，箍筋常為小直徑、大間距的開口箍，柱底主筋以短搭接接到基礎預留筋，剪力強度也只依彈性地震力計算。地震時這三種缺陷分別導致脆性剪力破壞、保護層剝落後核心壓碎與主筋挫屈，以及柱底搭接滑脫。纖維複材套管的策略是在柱外包覆以環向為主的纖維，像額外的箍筋一樣抑制斜裂縫張開、圍束核心混凝土並夾緊搭接段，而不增加縱向彎矩強度。~Piers designed before the 1970s often have small, widely spaced open hoops, column bars lapped onto short footing starter bars at the base, and shear strength sized only for elastic seismic forces. In an earthquake these three deficiencies lead respectively to brittle shear failure, core crushing and bar buckling after cover spalling, and slip of the base lap splice. The FRP jacket strategy wraps the column with mainly hoop-direction fibres that act like extra hoops, restraining diagonal crack opening, confining the core and clamping the splice zone, without adding longitudinal flexural strength.
units.model: 既有柱推覆分析：降伏位移 Δ_y = 0.08 m，因剪力破壞在 Δ = 0.12 m 時強度驟降，位移韌性容量 μ_c = 0.12/0.08 = 1.5；設計位移需求 Δ_D = 0.28 m，μ_D = 3.5，需求為容量的 2.3 倍，判定需補強。數值為教學假設。~Pushover of an existing column: yield displacement Δ_y = 0.08 m, with shear failure dropping strength at Δ = 0.12 m, so displacement ductility capacity μ_c = 0.12/0.08 = 1.5; a design demand Δ_D = 0.28 m means μ_D = 3.5, 2.3 times capacity, so retrofit is required. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以竣工圖、現地鋼筋掃描與局部打除確認箍筋直徑、間距、彎鉤型式與柱底搭接長度，再以推覆分析同時繪出彎曲與剪力容量曲線，判斷控制的破壞模式；補強需求須針對各缺陷分開計算。~Confirm hoop size, spacing, hook type and base splice length from as-built drawings, site rebar scanning and local breakouts, then run a pushover with both flexural and shear capacity curves to identify the governing failure mode; compute retrofit needs separately for each deficiency.
units.failure: 若只看到柱身裂縫就全面包覆而未判斷缺陷類型，可能把纖維用在不需要的位置，而真正的弱點（例如帽梁接頭或基礎）仍未處理；包覆後外觀完整，反而讓管理單位誤以為橋墩已符合耐震要求。~Wrapping every cracked column without identifying the deficiency type can put fibres where they are not needed while the real weakness, such as the cap-beam joint or footing, remains untreated; the intact appearance after wrapping can then mislead the owner into believing the pier now meets seismic requirements.
units.misconception: 只要把橋墩包上碳纖維，就能解決所有耐震問題。~Wrapping a pier in carbon fibre solves all of its seismic problems.
units.practice: 補強設計報告須列出每一座橋墩的缺陷類型、控制破壞模式、補強目標（剪力、圍束、搭接夾持）與未處理的其他弱點，並由審查工程師確認補強範圍與優先順序。~The retrofit design report lists, for each pier, the deficiency type, governing failure mode, retrofit target (shear, confinement or splice clamping) and any other weaknesses left untreated, with the checking engineer confirming scope and priority.

units.anchor: 套管端部間隙~Jacket end gap
units.title: 補強目標與能力保護~Retrofit targets and capacity protection
units.mechanism: 補強的目的是讓塑鉸能在柱端形成並延展，而不是把柱變得更強：若套管增加了柱的彎矩強度，地震時傳到基礎、帽梁與樁的力隨之增加，原本沒有問題的構件可能變成新的弱點。因此纖維主要沿環向布置，套管兩端通常與基礎頂面及帽梁底面留一小段間隙，避免套管直接承壓而增加斷面抗彎。圍束後的核心混凝土強度提高會讓塑性彎矩小幅上升，設計者必須以補強後的超強度彎矩重新檢核能力保護構件。~The goal of retrofit is to let the plastic hinge form and deform at the column end, not to make the column stronger: if the jacket increases flexural strength, the forces delivered to footing, cap beam and piles rise in an earthquake and members that were adequate can become new weak links. Fibres are therefore placed mainly in the hoop direction, and the jacket usually stops a small gap short of the footing top and cap-beam soffit so it does not bear directly and add flexural capacity. Confined core concrete still raises the plastic moment slightly, so the designer must recheck capacity-protected members with the retrofitted overstrength moment.
units.model: 既有柱 M_p = 10 MN·m，圍束後核心強度提高使 M_p 增為約 11 MN·m（+10%）；超強度彎矩 M_o = 1.2×11 = 13.2 MN·m。基礎抗彎容量 14 MN·m，比值 14/13.2 ≈ 1.06，仍可保護；若誤把縱向纖維錨入基礎使 M_p 增為 13 MN·m，M_o = 15.6 MN·m，基礎不足。數值為教學假設。~The existing column has M_p = 10 MN·m; core confinement raises it to about 11 MN·m (+10%), so M_o = 1.2×11 = 13.2 MN·m. A footing flexural capacity of 14 MN·m gives 14/13.2 ≈ 1.06, still protected; wrongly anchoring longitudinal fibres into the footing to give M_p = 13 MN·m makes M_o = 15.6 MN·m and the footing inadequate. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以圍束混凝土模型重算補強後的彎矩—曲率關係，取得新的 M_p 與 M_o，逐一核對基礎、樁、帽梁與接頭；圖面須標示纖維方向、層數、包覆範圍與端部間隙，現場量測間隙是否保留。~Recompute the moment–curvature relation with a confined-concrete model to obtain the new M_p and M_o and check footing, piles, cap beam and joints one by one; drawings show fibre direction, ply count, wrap extent and end gaps, and the gaps are measured on site.
units.failure: 套管一路包到基礎頂面並以樹脂灌滿間隙，柱底在地震中形同加大斷面，塑鉸被迫轉移到套管以上未補強的區段，或把超額彎矩推進基礎，造成基礎剪力或樁頭破壞。~Wrapping down onto the footing and filling the gap with resin makes the column base act as an enlarged section in an earthquake, forcing the hinge up into the unwrapped region above the jacket or pushing excess moment into the foundation, causing footing shear or pile-head failure.
units.misconception: 補強後橋墩越強越好，連基礎與帽梁的受力都不用重新檢查。~After retrofit the stronger the pier the better, with no need to recheck footing and cap-beam forces.
units.practice: 補強計算書要包含補強前後 M_p、M_o 的對照與能力保護檢核；施工規範明定端部間隙尺寸，施工期間不得以砂漿或樹脂填滿，並在竣工檢查中逐柱確認。~Retrofit calculations compare M_p and M_o before and after and include capacity-protection checks; the specification fixes the end-gap size, which must not be filled with mortar or resin during construction and is confirmed column by column at final inspection.

units.anchor: 纖維有效應變 ε_fe~Effective fibre strain ε_fe
units.title: 纖維複材材料與有效應變~FRP materials and effective strain
units.mechanism: 橋墩補強常用碳纖維或玻璃纖維織物，以環氧樹脂含浸後積層，或採工廠預製殼片。纖維在破斷前近乎線彈性、沒有降伏平台，因此設計不以強度而以「有效應變」控制：實際套管在圓角、搭接與混凝土不均勻膨脹處會提早破斷，所以只取材料破斷應變的一部分。長期環境（濕熱、鹼性、紫外線）又會降低性能，玻璃纖維對鹼與濕氣較敏感，故設計值要再乘以環境折減係數。~Pier retrofits commonly use carbon or glass fabrics saturated with epoxy and laminated, or factory-made prefabricated shells. The fibres are nearly linear-elastic to rupture with no yield plateau, so design is controlled by effective strain rather than strength: real jackets rupture early at corners, overlaps and where the concrete dilates unevenly, so only part of the material's rupture strain is used. Long-term environment (moisture, heat, alkalinity and UV) also reduces performance, and glass fibre is more sensitive to alkali and moisture, so design values are multiplied by an environmental reduction factor.
units.model: 設計破斷應變 ε_fu = C_E·ε*_fu，有效應變 ε_fe = κ_ε·ε_fu。碳纖維 ε*_fu = 0.017、戶外 C_E = 0.85、κ_ε = 0.55：ε_fu = 0.01445，ε_fe ≈ 0.0079；若改用玻璃纖維 ε*_fu = 0.021、C_E = 0.65，ε_fe = 0.55×0.65×0.021 ≈ 0.0075。數值為教學假設，產品性質以試驗為準。~Design rupture strain ε_fu = C_E·ε*_fu and effective strain ε_fe = κ_ε·ε_fu. For carbon with ε*_fu = 0.017, exterior C_E = 0.85 and κ_ε = 0.55: ε_fu = 0.01445 and ε_fe ≈ 0.0079; glass with ε*_fu = 0.021 and C_E = 0.65 gives ε_fe = 0.55×0.65×0.021 ≈ 0.0075. Values are teaching assumptions; product properties come from tests.
units.verify: 審查纖維系統的拉伸試驗報告（以每單位寬度的強度與勁度表示）、樹脂玻璃轉移溫度、耐久試驗與既有工程紀錄；現場製作見證試片並送驗，確認積層後的強度與彈性模數不低於設計採用值。~Review the system's tensile test reports (strength and stiffness per unit width), resin glass-transition temperature, durability tests and track record; make witnessed site panels for testing to confirm laminate strength and modulus are not below design values.
units.failure: 若直接以產品型錄的破斷應變設計而忽略有效應變與環境折減，計算的圍束壓力與剪力貢獻被高估，地震時套管在圓角或搭接端提早破斷，核心混凝土突然失去圍束。~Designing directly with catalogue rupture strain while ignoring effective strain and environmental reduction overestimates confining pressure and shear contribution, so in an earthquake the jacket ruptures early at a corner or overlap end and the core suddenly loses confinement.
units.misconception: 碳纖維強度是鋼材的數倍，所以用一層就能取代大量箍筋。~Carbon fibre is several times stronger than steel, so one ply can replace a large amount of hoop steel.
units.practice: 規格書要指定纖維系統的性質以「淨纖維面積」或「積層厚度」哪一種定義，並與設計計算一致；不得在施工中更換不同系統，除非重新計算並經設計者核准。~The specification states whether system properties are defined on net-fibre area or laminate thickness, consistent with the design calculation; switching to a different system during construction is not allowed without recalculation and designer approval.

units.anchor: 圍束側壓 f_l~Confining pressure f_l
units.title: 圍束壓力、層數與剪力貢獻~Confining pressure, ply count and shear contribution
units.mechanism: 混凝土受壓後橫向膨脹，環向纖維被拉緊而對核心施加側向圍束壓力，壓力大小與纖維勁度、層數及有效應變成正比、與柱徑成反比，因此大直徑橋柱需要更多層。圍束壓力太低時，混凝土強度與極限應變的提升不明顯，設計指引因此設下最小圍束比。同一套管也提供剪力強度：斜裂縫張開時，跨越裂縫的環向纖維受拉抵抗，但為了保持骨材互鎖，剪力計算的纖維應變上限比圍束更嚴。~When compressed concrete expands laterally, the hoop fibres tighten and apply confining pressure to the core; the pressure is proportional to fibre stiffness, ply count and effective strain and inversely proportional to column diameter, so large bridge columns need more plies. With too little pressure the gains in concrete strength and ultimate strain are insignificant, so guidance sets a minimum confinement ratio. The same jacket also supplies shear strength: as diagonal cracks open, hoop fibres crossing them resist in tension, but the strain limit for shear is stricter than for confinement to preserve aggregate interlock.
units.model: 圓柱圍束壓力 f_l = 2·E_f·n·t_f·ε_fe/D。E_f = 230 GPa、t_f = 0.165 mm、ε_fe = 0.0079、D = 1,500 mm：4 層 f_l ≈ 1.61 MPa，f_l/f′_c = 1.61/27.5 ≈ 0.058，低於 0.08；6 層 f_l ≈ 2.41 MPa，比值 ≈ 0.088，符合。數值為教學假設。~Circular-column confining pressure f_l = 2·E_f·n·t_f·ε_fe/D. With E_f = 230 GPa, t_f = 0.165 mm, ε_fe = 0.0079 and D = 1,500 mm: 4 plies give f_l ≈ 1.61 MPa and f_l/f′_c = 1.61/27.5 ≈ 0.058, below 0.08; 6 plies give f_l ≈ 2.41 MPa, a ratio of about 0.088, which is acceptable. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以設計指引的圍束混凝土模型計算補強後的 f′_cc 與極限應變，代入彎矩—曲率與推覆分析確認位移容量大於需求；剪力部分以較低的纖維應變上限計算套管貢獻，並與彎曲容量對應的剪力需求比較。~Compute the retrofitted f′_cc and ultimate strain with the guide's confined-concrete model, feed them into moment–curvature and pushover analyses to confirm displacement capacity exceeds demand, and calculate the jacket's shear contribution with the lower fibre-strain limit, comparing it with the shear demand at flexural capacity.
units.failure: 矩形或長寬比大的橋墩，纖維只在角落附近有效圍束，長邊中段向外鼓出；若仍以圓柱公式計算，會大幅高估圍束效果，地震時長邊中段保護層與核心剝落、主筋挫屈。~On rectangular or elongated piers the fibres confine effectively only near the corners while the long sides bulge outward; using the circular-column formula greatly overestimates confinement, and in an earthquake the mid-length of the long side spalls, the core crushes and bars buckle.
units.misconception: 纖維層數加倍，圍束與剪力效果一定也加倍，且不受柱徑影響。~Doubling the plies always doubles confinement and shear benefit, regardless of column diameter.
units.practice: 大長寬比矩形墩宜考慮以混凝土補成橢圓或圓形斷面後再包覆，或改用其他補強方式；計算書明列每一段的層數、包覆高度與採用的應變上限，並說明圍束比是否滿足最小值。~For elongated rectangular piers consider building the section out to an oval or circle with concrete before wrapping, or use another retrofit method; calculations list ply count, wrap height and strain limit for each zone and state whether the minimum confinement ratio is met.

units.anchor: 表面處理與露點~Surface preparation and dew point
units.title: 基面處理、圓角與施工環境~Substrate preparation, corner rounding and site conditions
units.mechanism: 纖維套管的效果建立在纖維緊貼混凝土上：圍束型套管靠接觸傳力，剪力與搭接夾持則需要良好黏結。施工前要清除劣化混凝土、修補剝落並灌注裂縫，以研磨去除表面浮漿與油污；矩形斷面的角隅必須磨圓，否則纖維在尖角處應力集中而提早斷裂。樹脂對濕氣與溫度敏感，混凝土表面若有凝結水，黏結會失效，因此施工時要量測表面溫度、氣溫、相對濕度與露點。~A jacket works only if the fibres sit tight on the concrete: confinement jackets transfer force by contact, while shear and splice clamping need good bond. Before application, deteriorated concrete is removed, spalls repaired and cracks injected, and the surface ground to remove laitance and oil; corners of rectangular sections must be rounded, or fibres concentrate stress at sharp edges and rupture early. Resins are sensitive to moisture and temperature, and condensation on the concrete defeats bond, so surface temperature, air temperature, relative humidity and dew point are measured during application.
units.model: Magnus 公式露點 T_d = 243.12·γ/(17.62 − γ)，γ = ln(RH/100) + 17.62·T/(243.12+T)。氣溫 28°C、RH 80%：γ ≈ 1.597，T_d ≈ 24.2°C；混凝土表面 24°C 低於 T_d + 3°C ≈ 27.2°C，應停止施作。數值為教學假設。~Magnus dew point T_d = 243.12·γ/(17.62 − γ) with γ = ln(RH/100) + 17.62·T/(243.12+T). At 28°C air and 80% RH, γ ≈ 1.597 and T_d ≈ 24.2°C; a 24°C concrete surface is below T_d + 3°C ≈ 27.2°C, so work should stop. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每次施作前記錄氣溫、相對濕度、表面溫度與露點，確認表面含水率與溫度在樹脂製造商規定範圍；以量規檢查角隅圓角半徑（設計指引常要求不小於約 13 mm），並以平整度尺檢查凹凸。~Before each application record air temperature, relative humidity, surface temperature and dew point, confirming surface moisture and temperature are within the resin maker's limits; check corner radius with a gauge (guidance commonly requires at least about 13 mm) and surface irregularities with a straightedge.
units.failure: 在清晨潮濕或雨後表面未乾時施作，樹脂與混凝土之間形成水膜，外觀看似完整，實際黏結強度很低；未磨圓的角隅讓纖維在地震前就因應力集中斷絲，套管的圍束能力在最需要時不存在。~Applying on a damp early morning or before the surface dries after rain leaves a water film between resin and concrete that looks intact but has very low bond; unrounded corners let fibres break filament by filament at stress concentrations, so confinement is missing when it is needed most.
units.misconception: 樹脂可以在任何天氣下施作，只要多塗一層就能彌補潮濕。~Resin can be applied in any weather; an extra coat makes up for dampness.
units.practice: 施工計畫列出可施作的環境條件與停止條件，每日由施工與監造共同簽認環境紀錄；基面處理完成列為停留點，經檢查圓角、修補與清潔後才可開始積層。~The work plan lists allowable conditions and stop conditions, with the contractor and inspector co-signing daily environmental records; completed substrate preparation is a hold point, and lay-up begins only after corners, repairs and cleanliness are inspected.

units.anchor: 環向搭接長度~Hoop overlap length
units.title: 濕式積層、預製殼片與塑鉸區範圍~Wet lay-up, prefabricated shells and hinge-zone extent
units.mechanism: 濕式積層是在現場把樹脂含浸的纖維織物一層層繞柱包覆，每一圈末端以規定長度搭接，讓纖維拉力能經由樹脂傳遞；纖維方向偏斜、皺摺或氣泡都會降低效果。預製殼片則在工廠成型，現場套在柱外並以灌漿填滿殼片與柱之間的間隙。舊金山一座碼頭約 250 支直徑 4 呎的沉箱，就以預製套管留出約 2 吋間隙、外加濕式積層並灌入無收縮砂漿完成補強。包覆範圍至少要涵蓋可能的塑鉸區，例如賓州 I-84 跨越橋在每支柱頂與柱底各取 5 呎塑鉸區。~Wet lay-up wraps resin-saturated fabric around the column ply by ply on site, each ply ending in a specified overlap so fibre tension passes through the resin; misaligned fibres, wrinkles or air pockets reduce performance. Prefabricated shells are formed in the factory, placed around the column and the gap filled with grout. About 250 caissons, 4 ft in diameter, of a San Francisco pier were strengthened with prefabricated jackets set with an approximately 2 inch gap, additional wet lay-up and non-shrink grout. The wrapped extent must cover the potential hinge zones; on a Pennsylvania I-84 overpass, 5 ft hinge zones were taken at the top and bottom of each column.
units.model: D = 1.5 m 柱周長 C = π×1.5 ≈ 4.71 m，每層加搭接 0.15 m 為 4.86 m；塑鉸區高 1.5 m、6 層，所需纖維面積 4.86×1.5×6 ≈ 43.8 m²（單一柱端）；纖維方向偏斜 10° 時環向有效勁度約降為 cos²10° ≈ 97%。數值為教學假設。~For D = 1.5 m the circumference is C = π×1.5 ≈ 4.71 m, or 4.86 m per ply with a 0.15 m overlap; a 1.5 m hinge zone with 6 plies needs 4.86×1.5×6 ≈ 43.8 m² of fabric per column end; a 10° fibre misalignment cuts effective hoop stiffness to about cos²10° ≈ 97%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 逐層記錄纖維批號、樹脂配比與混合時間、可使用時間、層數與搭接位置（相鄰層搭接錯開），以照片記錄纖維方向；完成後量測套管厚度並以敲擊檢查是否有空鼓，預製殼片則確認灌漿飽滿。~Record fabric batch, resin ratio and mixing time, pot life, ply count and overlap locations ply by ply (staggering adjacent overlaps), photographing fibre direction; afterwards measure laminate thickness and sound for hollow spots, and for prefabricated shells confirm full grouting.
units.failure: 搭接長度不足或所有層的搭接集中在同一位置，套管受拉時在搭接處滑脫，形成一條縱向弱線；樹脂超過可使用時間仍繼續塗布，含浸不良的纖維無法共同受力。~Short overlaps, or all plies overlapping at the same location, let the jacket slip at the overlap under tension, creating a vertical line of weakness; resin used beyond its pot life fails to saturate the fabric, so fibres do not share load.
units.misconception: 只要總層數正確，搭接位置與纖維方向並不重要。~As long as the total ply count is right, overlap location and fibre direction do not matter.
units.practice: 施工圖標示每一層的起訖位置與搭接錯開方式，樹脂混合有專人記錄時間；積層完成與灌漿完成各列為停留點，監造確認紀錄與外觀後才可進行面塗或下一段施工。~Shop drawings mark each ply's start and end and the overlap stagger, with a designated person timing resin batches; completed lay-up and completed grouting are hold points, and topcoat or the next zone proceeds only after the inspector checks records and appearance.

units.anchor: 拉拔試驗與敲擊檢查~Pull-off and sounding tests
units.title: 黏結拉拔、脫層與試片驗收~Bond pull-off, delamination and witness-panel acceptance
units.mechanism: 套管施工品質無法從外觀判斷，必須以試驗確認：拉拔試驗把圓形拉拔頭黏在硬化後的積層上、切穿至混凝土後垂直拉起，破壞面應在混凝土內，表示黏結強於基材；敲擊或紅外線熱影像可找出積層與混凝土之間的空鼓與脫層；見證試片則與現場同條件製作，送驗拉伸強度與彈性模數。這些結果與設計值比較，決定接受、修補或重做。~Jacket quality cannot be judged by appearance and must be confirmed by tests: in a pull-off test a circular dolly is bonded to the cured laminate, cored through to the concrete and pulled perpendicular, and the failure surface should lie in the concrete, showing the bond is stronger than the substrate; tapping or infrared thermography finds voids and delaminations between laminate and concrete; witness panels made under site conditions are tested for tensile strength and modulus. Results are compared with design values to decide acceptance, repair or rework.
units.model: 拉拔強度 σ = F/A。直徑 50 mm 拉拔頭面積 A = π×25² ≈ 1,963 mm²，破壞荷重 F = 2.8 kN，σ = 2,800/1,963 ≈ 1.43 MPa，且破壞面在混凝土內，達到常用的約 1.4 MPa 門檻；若破壞在樹脂界面且只有 0.9 MPa，判定黏結不良。數值為教學假設。~Pull-off strength σ = F/A. A 50 mm dolly has A = π×25² ≈ 1,963 mm²; a failure load F = 2.8 kN gives σ = 2,800/1,963 ≈ 1.43 MPa with failure in the concrete, meeting the common threshold of about 1.4 MPa; failure at the resin interface at only 0.9 MPa indicates poor bond. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 依試驗標準決定拉拔試驗的頻率與位置（避開關鍵受力區或事後修補），記錄破壞模式；以敲擊或熱影像全面檢查，標示脫層位置與面積，依指引的容許值（例如單一小脫層面積與每平方公尺數量上限）判定，超出者以注射或局部切除重貼修補。~Set pull-off test frequency and locations per the test standard, avoiding critical zones or repairing them afterwards, and record the failure mode; survey the whole jacket by sounding or thermography, map delamination location and area, and judge against guidance limits such as maximum single-void size and count per square metre, repairing exceedances by injection or cut-out and re-lamination.
units.failure: 只做外觀檢查而未拉拔與敲擊，脫層與含浸不良被面塗掩蓋；地震時脫層區無法傳遞剪力與夾持搭接，而見證試片若在室內理想條件製作，也無法代表現場品質。~Visual inspection without pull-off and sounding lets delamination and poor saturation hide under the topcoat; in an earthquake debonded areas cannot transfer shear or clamp the splice, and witness panels made indoors under ideal conditions do not represent site quality.
units.misconception: 纖維套管外觀平整沒有氣泡，就表示黏結良好。~If the jacket looks smooth with no bubbles, the bond must be good.
units.practice: 品質計畫要寫明拉拔、敲擊或熱影像、試片的頻率與允收準則，試驗由獨立單位見證；所有不合格處的修補方式與複驗結果都要附在竣工資料中。~The quality plan states frequency and acceptance criteria for pull-off, sounding or thermography and witness panels, with tests witnessed by an independent party; repair methods and retest results for every nonconformance are attached to the as-built records.

units.anchor: 補強前後遲滯比較~Before-and-after hysteresis comparison
units.title: 大尺寸柱試驗與性能驗證~Large-scale column tests and performance validation
units.mechanism: 纖維套管補強設計公式之所以可信，是因為研究機構以接近實尺寸的舊式配筋橋柱，在固定軸力下做補強前後的反覆載重比較試驗：未補強柱常在小漂移比時剪力破壞或搭接滑脫，補強柱則能發展穩定的彎曲遲滯迴圈並達到數倍的位移韌性。1990 年代加州大學聖地牙哥分校等實驗室的系列試驗，使複材套管成為鋼板套管以外的補強選項。試驗也揭示了限制：套管可能遮蔽損傷、端部間隙不當會改變塑鉸位置。~FRP retrofit formulas are credible because research laboratories tested near full-scale columns with old-style detailing under constant axial load, before and after retrofit: unretrofitted columns often failed in shear or by splice slip at small drift, while retrofitted ones developed stable flexural hysteresis and several times the displacement ductility. Test series in the 1990s at laboratories such as the University of California, San Diego made composite jackets an alternative to steel jackets. The tests also exposed limits: jackets can hide damage, and improper end gaps change where the hinge forms.
units.model: 柱高 L = 8 m 的試驗比較：未補強柱在漂移比 1.2%（Δ = 0.096 m）剪力破壞；補強柱強度降至最大值 80% 時漂移比 4.0%（Δ = 0.32 m）。降伏漂移比均約 0.8%（Δ_y = 0.064 m），位移韌性由 1.5 提升為 5.0。數值為教學假設。~A comparison for columns with L = 8 m: the unretrofitted column fails in shear at 1.2% drift (Δ = 0.096 m), while the retrofitted one falls to 80% of peak strength at 4.0% drift (Δ = 0.32 m). With yield drift about 0.8% for both (Δ_y = 0.064 m), displacement ductility rises from 1.5 to 5.0. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 引用試驗支持設計時，要比對試體的柱徑、軸力比、剪跨比、原有箍筋與搭接細節、纖維系統與層數是否與本案相近，並確認試驗包含反覆載重與足夠圈數；重要橋梁可要求以代表性柱做驗證試驗。~When citing tests in support of a design, compare specimen diameter, axial-load ratio, shear-span ratio, original hoop and splice details, fibre system and ply count with the project, and confirm the tests used reversed cyclic loading with enough cycles; important bridges can require a validation test on a representative column.
units.failure: 以不同纖維系統或不同細節的試驗結果套用到本案，可能高估補強後的韌性；若試驗只做到中等漂移比就停止，無法證明套管在設計位移下不會斷裂或脫層。~Applying test results from a different fibre system or different details can overestimate retrofitted ductility; tests stopped at moderate drift cannot show that the jacket will not rupture or debond at the design displacement.
units.misconception: 只要有一篇試驗證明碳纖維有效，任何橋柱都能直接套用同一設計。~One test showing carbon fibre works means any column can use the same design.
units.practice: 設計報告附上所引用試驗的清單與適用性比較表，並說明本案與試驗的差異如何以保守係數處理；採用新纖維系統時，要求供應商提供針對橋柱的反覆載重試驗證據。~The design report lists the cited tests with an applicability comparison table and explains how differences from the project are covered by conservative factors; for a new fibre system, require the supplier's cyclic test evidence on bridge columns.

units.anchor: 面塗、防撞與耐久~Topcoat, impact protection and durability
units.title: 紫外線、濕熱、撞擊與長期耐久~UV, moisture, impact and long-term durability
units.mechanism: 環氧樹脂暴露於紫外線會粉化，因此戶外套管需要面塗；長期濕熱與鹼性環境會降低樹脂與纖維界面的性能，玻璃纖維尤其敏感。橋墩位於河道或路旁時，還要面對漂流物、砂石磨耗與車輛撞擊，局部損傷會切斷環向纖維的連續性。碳纖維與鋼構件直接接觸可能引起電化學腐蝕，需以絕緣層隔開。賓州 I-84 跨越橋 1995 年完成的套管，在約 17 年後仍未見脫層，說明正確的材料選擇與保護可以提供長期性能。~Epoxy chalks under UV, so exterior jackets need a topcoat; long-term moisture, heat and alkalinity degrade the resin–fibre interface, glass fibre especially. Piers in rivers or beside roads also face debris, sediment abrasion and vehicle impact, and local damage breaks the continuity of hoop fibres. Carbon fibre in direct contact with steel can cause galvanic corrosion and needs an insulating layer. The jackets placed on the Pennsylvania I-84 overpass in 1995 showed no delamination about 17 years later, showing that correct material choice and protection can deliver long-term performance.
units.model: 設計抗拉強度 f_fu = C_E·f*_fu：碳纖維 f*_fu = 3,800 MPa、戶外 C_E = 0.85，f_fu = 3,230 MPa；玻璃纖維 f*_fu = 1,520 MPa、C_E = 0.65，f_fu = 988 MPa。若河中墩撞擊切斷 6 層中的 2 層，局部圍束壓力降為 4/6 ≈ 67%。數值為教學假設。~Design tensile strength f_fu = C_E·f*_fu: carbon with f*_fu = 3,800 MPa and exterior C_E = 0.85 gives 3,230 MPa; glass with f*_fu = 1,520 MPa and C_E = 0.65 gives 988 MPa. If impact on an in-river pier severs 2 of 6 plies, local confining pressure falls to 4/6 ≈ 67%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 定期檢查面塗粉化、裂紋、褪色、纖維外露、撞擊痕、底部積水與鏽水；以敲擊或熱影像比對交接時的基準圖，追蹤脫層是否擴大，並在撞擊後量測受損範圍與斷層數。~Inspect periodically for topcoat chalking, cracking, fading, exposed fibres, impact marks, water trapped at the base and rust staining; compare sounding or thermography with the handover baseline map to track growth of delamination, and after impact measure the damaged extent and number of severed plies.
units.failure: 未做面塗的套管數年後樹脂粉化、纖維外露，濕氣沿裂紋侵入；套管底部若密封不當，雨水積在套管與混凝土之間無法排出，混凝土與鋼筋在套管內持續劣化卻無法被看見。~Without a topcoat, the resin chalks and fibres become exposed within a few years, letting moisture in along cracks; a poorly sealed jacket base traps rainwater between jacket and concrete, so concrete and reinforcement keep deteriorating inside the jacket unseen.
units.misconception: 纖維複材不會生鏽，因此包覆後的橋墩不需要任何維護。~FRP does not rust, so a wrapped pier needs no maintenance.
units.practice: 設計時就決定面塗系統與重塗週期、底部排水或密封細節，以及河中墩或路旁墩的防撞與防磨耗保護；碳纖維與鋼件之間一律加絕緣層，並在維護手冊中列出局部修補程序。~Decide the topcoat system and recoat interval, base drainage or sealing details and impact or abrasion protection for in-river and roadside piers at design; always insulate carbon fibre from steel, and list local repair procedures in the maintenance manual.

units.anchor: 套管周長量測~Jacket circumference measurement
units.title: 震後檢查、補強紀錄與交接~Post-earthquake inspection, retrofit records and handover
units.mechanism: 套管把混凝土包起來，也把地震損傷藏起來：震後檢查員無法直接看到裂縫與剝落，只能從套管的鼓脹、皺褶、纖維斷裂、樹脂白化與底部碎屑判斷。量測套管周長變化是簡單有效的方法，因為核心混凝土膨脹會使套管環向伸長，換算的環向應變可與設計有效應變比較。因此交接時要留下每支柱的周長、厚度、熱影像基準與試驗結果，震後才能比較；判斷結果決定繼續使用、加層補強或拆除重做。~A jacket encloses the concrete and also hides earthquake damage: inspectors cannot see cracks and spalling directly and must read jacket bulging, wrinkles, broken fibres, resin whitening and debris at the base. Measuring the change in jacket circumference is simple and effective, because core dilation stretches the jacket in the hoop direction and the resulting hoop strain can be compared with the design effective strain. Handover must therefore record each column's circumference, thickness, thermography baseline and test results so post-earthquake comparison is possible; the judgement decides continued use, added plies or removal and rework.
units.model: 環向應變 ε = ΔC/C。D = 1.5 m 柱周長 C ≈ 4,712 mm，震後以周長尺量得增加 20 mm，ε = 20/4,712 ≈ 0.0042，約為設計有效應變 0.0079 的 53%，套管仍在作用，但已超過剪力計算常用的 0.004 上限，表示核心可能已明顯膨脹，需進一步檢查。數值為教學假設。~Hoop strain ε = ΔC/C. A D = 1.5 m column has C ≈ 4,712 mm; if a circumference tape shows a 20 mm increase after an earthquake, ε = 20/4,712 ≈ 0.0042, about 53% of the 0.0079 design effective strain, so the jacket is still working, but above the 0.004 limit often used for shear, indicating significant core dilation that needs further investigation. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 震後依程序量測每支補強柱在塑鉸區的周長、殘留傾斜與套管外觀，以熱影像比對基準，必要時局部開窗檢查核心；結果與交接基準比較後，由結構工程師簽認是否恢復通行。~After an earthquake measure each retrofitted column's hinge-zone circumference, residual tilt and jacket condition by procedure, compare thermography with the baseline and open inspection windows into the core where needed; after comparison with handover baselines a structural engineer signs off on reopening.
units.failure: 若交接時沒有記錄套管周長與熱影像基準，震後無法判斷變化是否來自地震；管理單位只看套管沒有破裂就恢復通行，實際核心可能已壓碎、主筋挫屈，餘震中軸向承載不足。~Without recorded circumference and thermography baselines at handover, post-earthquake changes cannot be attributed to the earthquake; an owner who reopens because the jacket did not rupture may miss a crushed core and buckled bars inside, leaving inadequate axial capacity in aftershocks.
units.misconception: 套管表面沒有破裂，就代表裡面的混凝土也沒有損傷。~If the jacket surface is not ruptured, the concrete inside is undamaged.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含補強設計計算、纖維系統與批號、層數與範圍竣工圖、環境與施工紀錄、拉拔與試片報告、熱影像與周長基準及震後檢查程序；恢復通行由主管機關指定的結構工程師簽認。~Handover includes retrofit calculations, fibre system and batch numbers, as-built ply and extent drawings, environmental and construction records, pull-off and panel reports, thermography and circumference baselines and the post-earthquake procedure; reopening is signed off by a structural engineer designated by the owner agency.

example: 設計練習：某舊圓形橋柱 D = 1.5 m、f′_c = 27.5 MPa，原有箍筋不足，推覆分析顯示 μ_c ≈ 1.5、設計需求 μ_D ≈ 3.5。採碳纖維濕式積層，E_f = 230 GPa、每層 t_f = 0.165 mm、ε*_fu = 0.017、戶外 C_E = 0.85、κ_ε = 0.55，得 ε_fe ≈ 0.0079。6 層時 f_l = 2×230,000×6×0.165×0.0079/1,500 ≈ 2.41 MPa，f_l/f′_c ≈ 0.088 ≥ 0.08。圍束強度 f′_cc = f′_c + 0.95×3.3×f_l ≈ 27.5 + 7.6 ≈ 35.1 MPa；極限應變 ε_ccu = 0.002×[1.5 + 12×0.088×(0.0079/0.002)^0.45] ≈ 0.0069，約為未圍束 0.003 的 2.3 倍。剪力貢獻以 0.004 應變上限、θ = 45° 計：V_j = (π/2)×6×0.165×230,000×0.004×1,500 ≈ 2.15 MN，乘以 0.85 折減後約 1.82 MN。若只用 4 層，f_l/f′_c ≈ 0.058，圍束增益不可計入，剪力貢獻也降為約 1.43 MN。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁或產品的設計。~Design exercise: an old circular column with D = 1.5 m and f′_c = 27.5 MPa has inadequate hoops, and pushover shows μ_c ≈ 1.5 against a demand μ_D ≈ 3.5. A carbon wet lay-up with E_f = 230 GPa, t_f = 0.165 mm per ply, ε*_fu = 0.017, exterior C_E = 0.85 and κ_ε = 0.55 gives ε_fe ≈ 0.0079. With 6 plies f_l = 2×230,000×6×0.165×0.0079/1,500 ≈ 2.41 MPa and f_l/f′_c ≈ 0.088, at least 0.08. Confined strength f′_cc = f′_c + 0.95×3.3×f_l ≈ 27.5 + 7.6 ≈ 35.1 MPa; ultimate strain ε_ccu = 0.002×[1.5 + 12×0.088×(0.0079/0.002)^0.45] ≈ 0.0069, about 2.3 times the unconfined 0.003. The shear contribution with a 0.004 strain limit and θ = 45° is V_j = (π/2)×6×0.165×230,000×0.004×1,500 ≈ 2.15 MN, about 1.82 MN after a 0.85 reduction. With only 4 plies f_l/f′_c ≈ 0.058, so no confinement gain may be counted, and the shear contribution falls to about 1.43 MN. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge or product.
history: 1989 年洛馬普列塔與 1994 年北嶺地震後，加州大規模以鋼板套管補強舊橋柱，同期以航太材料補強橋柱的纖維複材產業興起，Fyfe 公司即於 1988 年為此成立。1990 年代加州大學聖地牙哥分校等實驗室以大尺寸柱試驗驗證複材套管的圍束、剪力與搭接夾持效果，賓州 I-84 跨越橋在 1995 年於柱頂與柱底塑鉸區完成包覆，約 17 年後仍未見脫層；之後舊金山碼頭約 250 支沉箱也以預製套管加灌漿補強。fib 在 2001 年、美國混凝土學會 ACI 440 委員會在 2002 年起陸續發布外貼纖維複材設計指引，2017 年版納入耐震補強專章；台灣在 921 地震後推動既有橋梁耐震補強，纖維包覆成為與鋼板、混凝土套管並列的選項。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案或產品的設計文件。~After the 1989 Loma Prieta and 1994 Northridge earthquakes California retrofitted old bridge columns on a large scale with steel jackets, while an FRP strengthening industry using aerospace materials grew alongside; Fyfe was founded in 1988 for this purpose. In the 1990s laboratories such as the University of California, San Diego validated the confinement, shear and splice-clamping effect of composite jackets with large column tests; an I-84 overpass in Pennsylvania had its top and bottom hinge zones wrapped in 1995 and showed no delamination about 17 years later, and about 250 caissons of a San Francisco pier were later strengthened with prefabricated jackets and grout. fib in 2001 and ACI Committee 440 from 2002 published guidance for externally bonded FRP, the 2017 edition including a seismic strengthening chapter; in Taiwan the retrofit of existing bridges after the Chi-Chi earthquake made FRP wrapping an option alongside steel and concrete jackets. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's or product's design documents.
facts: 賓州斯克蘭頓 I-84 跨越橋的纖維套管於 1995 年施作，約 17 年後仍無脫層~The FRP jackets on the I-84 overpass in Scranton, Pennsylvania were installed in 1995 and showed no delamination about 17 years later
該橋為長約 468 呎的四跨連續結構，3 座橋墩各有 2 支直徑 5 呎的柱~That bridge is a four-span continuous structure about 468 ft long with 3 piers of 2 columns each, 5 ft in diameter
該案每支柱頂與柱底各取 5 呎作為塑鉸區範圍~The project took 5 ft at the top and bottom of each column as the plastic-hinge zones
舊金山一座碼頭約 250 支直徑 4 呎、高 30 呎的沉箱以預製纖維套管補強圍束與剪力~About 250 caissons of a San Francisco pier, 4 ft in diameter and 30 ft tall, were jacketed with prefabricated FRP for confinement and shear
該碼頭套管與沉箱間留約 2 吋間隙，再灌入無收縮砂漿~Those jackets were set with an approximately 2 inch gap to the caisson, filled with non-shrink grout
加州中部 3 座 Caltrans 跨越橋的剪力不足矩形柱，以碳纖維套管全高包覆取代鋼板套管~Shear-deficient rectangular columns of 3 Caltrans overpasses in central California were wrapped full height with carbon FRP instead of steel jackets
Fyfe 公司於 1988 年成立，最初目的是以航太材料補強劣化的橋柱~Fyfe was founded in 1988 to strengthen failing bridge columns with aerospace materials
ACI PRC-440.2-17 外貼纖維複材設計指引共 112 頁，含耐震補強與圍束專章~ACI PRC-440.2-17, the 112-page guide for externally bonded FRP, includes a seismic strengthening chapter with FRP confinement
常用碳纖維套管設計有效應變約 0.004 至 0.008，依用途（剪力或圍束）而定~Typical design effective strains for carbon jackets are about 0.004 to 0.008, depending on whether shear or confinement governs

timeline.event: Fyfe 公司成立，以航太纖維材料補強橋柱~Fyfe is founded to strengthen bridge columns with aerospace fibre materials
洛馬普列塔與北嶺地震促使加州大規模補強舊橋柱，複材套管開始研究驗證~The Loma Prieta and Northridge earthquakes drive large-scale column retrofit in California, and composite jackets enter research validation
賓州 I-84 跨越橋以纖維套管包覆柱頂與柱底塑鉸區~An I-84 overpass in Pennsylvania has its column top and bottom hinge zones wrapped with FRP
fib 第 14 號公報與 ACI 440.2R 初版發布外貼纖維複材設計指引~fib Bulletin 14 and the first ACI 440.2R publish design guidance for externally bonded FRP
ACI 440.2R-17 版發布，納入耐震補強與圍束專章~ACI 440.2R-17 is issued with a chapter on seismic strengthening and confinement

AASHTO 黏貼式纖維複材修復與補強混凝土橋梁構件設計指引規範~AASHTO Guide Specifications for Design of Bonded FRP Systems for Repair and Strengthening of Concrete Bridge Elements
fib 第 14 號公報：鋼筋混凝土結構外貼纖維複材補強~fib Bulletin 14: Externally bonded FRP reinforcement for RC structures
